newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Premier says behind FAI trade.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Premier says behind FAI trade.

text.p: Premier Investments Ltd said on Friday it was the seller of a large parcel of FAI Insurances Ltd shares which traded after the market closed.
Premier said the parcel represented its entire stake in FAI and the shares were crossed at 72 cents each to various institutions by brokerage firm Prudential-Bache.
"The directors will consider appropriate uses for the cash release," Premier said. It gave no more details.
Earlier, brokers told Reuters the trade comprised 45.93 million FAI shares or about 15 percent of the insurer's issued capital.
FAI shares closed three cents higher at 73 cents on Friday.
Premier, which is controlled by Australian businessman Solomon Lew, was the second biggest shareholder in FAI behind the Adler family which owns about 30 percent.
A spokesman for Premier was not immediately available for comment.
Lew, the major shareholder in retail giant Coles Myer Ltd with about 14 percent of company, said in August that he planned to lift his Coles stake.
